text:
XLAT::src_addr
Description
This iRules command returns the string representation of the source
translation address.
Syntax
XLAT
::
src_addr
Examples
when
SA_PICKED
{
log
local0.
"[XLAT::src_addr]"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
SA_PICKED
